scope: One shared signed N/N+1 fixture set plus a small synthetic revocation variant; exact approved 19 media assets and exact S12 core payloads.

inventory.contains: Exact SHA-256 and length of all 89 files per variant, source core payloads, six real M0 validator results and three reference metadata transition results.

variants.name: N
variants.meaning: Initial media metadata adoption in an isolated empty test store.

variants.name: N+1
variants.meaning: Same media manifest and all 38 image records; only catalog approval_join metadata changes, with corresponding signed policy/evidence rebind and sequence/revision increment. No title, date, saint, rights or image fact changes.

variants.name: N+2 synthetic revocation
variants.meaning: TEST ONLY: a cumulative, global slava-default tombstone and withdrawn catalog item. This is not a real owner decision or rights withdrawal. Fresh and N→N+1→N+2 reference outcomes match.

shared_payload.signature_scheme: RSA-2048 PSS / SHA-256 / MGF1-SHA256 / salt length 32
shared_payload.preserved: All seven S12 module IDs, versions, revisions, dependencies, capabilities and raw payloads. Only their manifest key_id/signatures and transport locations are rebound to the test key. Original 19 media bytes, stable IDs, titles, captions, default day1–day7 membership and null calendar bindings are unchanged.

test_trust.note: One ephemeral RSA KeyObject was generated in the builder process. It was never exported or returned; the process has ended. Inject the public key through a controlled test harness, never trust a public key downloaded from fixture transport.

actual_validation.source_s12: Existing real RSA verifier accepted the original production index, release set, seven manifests, exact payloads and graph using only its pinned public key.
actual_validation.fixture_m0_profiles: 6/6 PASS: three signed variants × android/ios contexts; all nine modules active, schema/dependency/hash/length/budget checks and actual Sharp full image decode.
actual_validation.targeted_tests: 15/15 PASS, zero skipped, 1183.761334 ms. Read-only stage readback, 33 detached signatures, source preservation, exact graph, full R2 image structure/decode once for all 38 files, N/N+1 transitions, fresh/upgrade revocation, rollback/checkpoint-loss/tamper and real M0 wrong-key/channel/client/capability/replay rejection.

commands.warning: Every rebuild generates a different ephemeral key and randomized RSA-PSS signatures. Both OS owners must consume the SAME delivered stage and public key, not build independently. No server was started.

remaining_native_test_mapping: Inject only the test public key, development channel, explicit fixture clock/client context and existing dormant capabilities in isolated native test stores; do not reset a production S12 high-water or modify production config.

Later route index.json, index.sig and their signed relative paths from the chosen variant through the actual native host/transport adapter. These local files alone do not prove HTTP/HTTPS, range/redirect, cancellation or platform delivery behavior.

Native M2/M5 must verify metadata adoption and image installation separately, persist exact actual F2 authority/receipt identities, and prove N+1 does not reuse an old catalog receipt merely because image hashes match.
Synthetic N+2 must exercise global tombstone behavior, checkpoint persistence and recovery; the shared reference checks are not a native restart, filesystem or reader test.
Fixture payloads are regular-file hardlinks only within their fresh staging root. Copy into a separate test sandbox before any destructive fault injection; never alter the shared fixtures in place.
